review_evidence: README states the repository is a blueprint for formalising finite automata and context-free grammars in Lean 4.

Complete inspection of the two current-primary files found autth.lean as the import entry point and autth/Example.lean defining an alphabet, grammar/rules and four language-membership theorem statements with three checked proofs and one explicit sorry.
The example role is substantive subject formalization rather than disposable test scaffolding, so no repository-local exclusion is justified.
summary: Retain autth: its compact Lean source develops concrete regular-language and context-free-grammar examples with checked theorem proofs.
